vBRIEFInfo.author: agent:deft-directive-setup
vBRIEFInfo.description: Scope vBRIEF for asset catalog and prompt-managed art workflow

narratives.Overview: Define a structured asset system for OtterFlop so every generated visual has a stable ID, a matching prompt record in the assets folder, and a filename/content mapping that aligns with the game's unlock and rendering logic.
narratives.Requirements: FR-1: The project includes an assets folder that stores the generation prompt for every image asset. FR-2: Every image asset has a stable ID that matches the content IDs used by the game for otter kids, outfits, scenes, parents, and UI art. FR-3: Prompt definitions are reviewable before image generation begins. FR-4: The asset pipeline supports layered dress-up content so new outfits can be added later without renaming or breaking prior asset references. NFR-1: Asset naming and IDs must be deterministic and human-auditable. NFR-2: The prompt catalog must preserve style consistency across future content additions.
narratives.Traces: Implements FR-1 through FR-4 and NFR-1 through NFR-2.
